title: Redox-programmable quantum dots for high-valence and strongly redox-active ion recognition: from reactivity windows to adaptive MXene platforms
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22841-22860
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01064D, Review Article

Mohamed Abu Shuheil, Omar Fadaam, Roopashree R., Subhashree Ray, Baraa Mohammed Yaseen, Kavitha V., Renu Sharma, Aashna Sinha, Ahmad Mohebi
Redox-programmable MXene quantum dots (MQDs) enable controlled detection of aggressive high-valence ions. This review connects ion reactivity windows with quantum-confinement redox control to guide adaptive sensing and validation strategies.
